#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pushes the release zips in a directory as one OCI index that's both an image
# and a store of the binaries:
#
#   docker run ghcr.io/kjanat/kprint:<tag> fmt
#   oras pull --platform linux/amd64 ghcr.io/kjanat/kprint:<tag>  # ./usr/local/bin/kprint (and dprint)
#   oras pull --platform darwin/arm64 ghcr.io/kjanat/kprint:<tag> # ./kprint-aarch64-apple-darwin.zip
#
# linux/amd64, linux/arm64 and linux/ppc64le are distroless images with the
# static musl build, whose layer of it ORAS unpacks (its base's layers have no
# file name, so ORAS skips them). Every other zip is an artifact of its
# platform, which has no image.
#
# Usage: docker-index.sh <image> <zips dir> <tag>... (logged in with oras)
# With ORAS_OCI_LAYOUT=1, <image> is an OCI image layout directory to try it.
set -euo pipefail
shopt -s inherit_errexit

push_flags=()
[[ "${ORAS_OCI_LAYOUT:-}" == 1 ]] && push_flags=(--oci-layout)

image="$1"
zips="$2"
shift 2
base=gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13:nonroot
source_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-kjanat/kprint}"
work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "${work}"' EXIT

oci_manifest=application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json
oci_index=application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json
oci_layer=application/vnd.oci.image.layer.v1.tar+gzip
empty_digest=sha256:44136fa355b3678a1146ad16f7e8649e94fb4fc21fe77e8310c060f61caaff8a

digest() {
	local sum
	sum="$(sha256sum <"$1")"
	echo "sha256:${sum%% *}"
}
size() { stat -c %s "$1"; }

# pushes a manifest by its digest, printing its descriptor
push_manifest() {
	local file="$1" platform="$2" artifact_type="${3:-}"
	local file_digest file_size
	file_digest="$(digest "${file}")"
	file_size="$(size "${file}")"
	oras manifest push "${push_flags[@]}" --media-type "${oci_manifest}" "${image}@${file_digest}" "${file}" >/dev/null
	jq -nc --arg digest "${file_digest}" --argjson size "${file_size}" --argjson platform "${platform}" \
		--arg artifact_type "${artifact_type}" --arg media_type "${oci_manifest}" \
		'{mediaType: $media_type, digest: $digest, size: $size, platform: $platform}
      + if $artifact_type == "" then {} else {artifactType: $artifact_type} end'
}

image_manifest() {
	local arch="$1" zip="$2"
	local dir="${work}/${arch}"
	mkdir -p "${dir}/root/usr/local/bin"
	unzip -q -o "${zip}" kprint -d "${dir}/root/usr/local/bin"
	chmod 0755 "${dir}/root/usr/local/bin/kprint"
	# dprint too, for what calls that, which tar stores as a link to kprint
	ln "${dir}/root/usr/local/bin/kprint" "${dir}/root/usr/local/bin/dprint"

	# the base's config and layers, as OCI
	oras manifest fetch --platform "linux/${arch}" "${base}" >"${dir}/base.json"
	local config_digest
	config_digest="$(jq -r .config.digest "${dir}/base.json")"
	oras blob fetch --output "${dir}/base-config.json" "${base%:*}@${config_digest}"
	local layers='[]' layer_digests layer_digest layer_size
	layer_digests="$(jq -r '.layers[].digest' "${dir}/base.json")"
	for layer_digest in ${layer_digests}; do
		oras blob fetch --output "${dir}/layer" "${base%:*}@${layer_digest}"
		oras blob push "${push_flags[@]}" "${image}" "${dir}/layer" >/dev/null
		layer_size="$(size "${dir}/layer")"
		layers="$(jq -c --arg digest "${layer_digest}" --argjson size "${layer_size}" --arg media_type "${oci_layer}" \
			'. + [{mediaType: $media_type, digest: $digest, size: $size}]' <<<"${layers}")"
	done

	# the binary's layer, which ORAS unpacks into ./usr. Its digest annotation
	# is of what a tar reader reads, which is no further than the end of the
	# archive, so it's written without padding after it.
	tar --create --file "${dir}/kprint.tar" --directory "${dir}/root" --sort=name --mtime=@0 \
		--owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=0755 \
		--blocking-factor=1 usr
	gzip -9 -n -c "${dir}/kprint.tar" >"${dir}/kprint.tar.gz"
	local tar_digest gz_digest gz_size
	tar_digest="$(digest "${dir}/kprint.tar")"
	gz_digest="$(digest "${dir}/kprint.tar.gz")"
	gz_size="$(size "${dir}/kprint.tar.gz")"
	oras blob push "${push_flags[@]}" "${image}" "${dir}/kprint.tar.gz" >/dev/null
	layers="$(jq -c --arg digest "${gz_digest}" --argjson size "${gz_size}" \
		--arg tar_digest "${tar_digest}" --arg media_type "${oci_layer}" \
		'. + [{mediaType: $media_type, digest: $digest, size: $size, annotations: {
      "org.opencontainers.image.title": "usr",
      "io.deis.oras.content.unpack": "true",
      "io.deis.oras.content.digest": $tar_digest
    }}]' <<<"${layers}")"

	jq -c --arg diff_id "${tar_digest}" '
    .rootfs.diff_ids += [$diff_id]
    | .config.Entrypoint = ["/usr/local/bin/kprint"]
    | .config.Cmd = null
    | .config.WorkingDir = "/work"
    | .history += [{created: "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z", created_by: "COPY kprint /usr/local/bin/kprint"}]
  ' "${dir}/base-config.json" >"${dir}/config.json"
	oras blob push "${push_flags[@]}" "${image}" "${dir}/config.json" >/dev/null

	local new_config_digest new_config_size platform
	new_config_digest="$(digest "${dir}/config.json")"
	new_config_size="$(size "${dir}/config.json")"
	jq -nc --arg config_digest "${new_config_digest}" --argjson config_size "${new_config_size}" \
		--argjson layers "${layers}" --arg source "${source_url}" --arg media_type "${oci_manifest}" '{
      schemaVersion: 2,
      mediaType: $media_type,
      config: {mediaType: "application/vnd.oci.image.config.v1+json", digest: $config_digest, size: $config_size},
      layers: $layers,
      annotations: {"org.opencontainers.image.source": $source}
    }' >"${dir}/manifest.json"
	platform="$(jq -nc --arg arch "${arch}" '{os: "linux", architecture: $arch}')"
	push_manifest "${dir}/manifest.json" "${platform}"
}

artifact_manifest() {
	local platform="$1" zip="$2" name dir zip_digest zip_size
	name="$(basename "${zip}")"
	dir="${work}/${name}"
	mkdir -p "${dir}"
	zip_digest="$(digest "${zip}")"
	zip_size="$(size "${zip}")"
	oras blob push "${push_flags[@]}" "${image}" "${zip}" >/dev/null
	jq -nc --arg digest "${zip_digest}" --argjson size "${zip_size}" --arg name "${name}" \
		--arg source "${source_url}" --arg media_type "${oci_manifest}" --arg empty "${empty_digest}" '{
      schemaVersion: 2,
      mediaType: $media_type,
      artifactType: "application/vnd.kprint.release.zip",
      config: {mediaType: "application/vnd.oci.empty.v1+json", digest: $empty, size: 2},
      layers: [{mediaType: "application/zip", digest: $digest, size: $size, annotations: {"org.opencontainers.image.title": $name}}],
      annotations: {"org.opencontainers.image.source": $source}
    }' >"${dir}/manifest.json"
	push_manifest "${dir}/manifest.json" "${platform}" application/vnd.kprint.release.zip
}

# the OCI platform of a target, which a gnu build only gets without a musl one
platform_of() {
	local target="$1" arch os
	case "${target}" in
		x86_64-*) arch=amd64 ;;
		aarch64-*) arch=arm64 ;;
		riscv64gc-*) arch=riscv64 ;;
		loongarch64-*) arch=loong64 ;;
		powerpc64le-*) arch=ppc64le ;;
		*)
			echo "Unknown target ${target}" >&2
			return 1
			;;
	esac
	case "${target}" in
		*-apple-darwin) os=darwin ;;
		*-pc-windows-msvc) os=windows ;;
		*-unknown-freebsd) os=freebsd ;;
		*-linux-android) os=android ;;
		*-unknown-linux-*) os=linux ;;
		*)
			echo "Unknown target ${target}" >&2
			return 1
			;;
	esac
	jq -nc --arg os "${os}" --arg arch "${arch}" '{os: $os, architecture: $arch}'
}

printf '{}' >"${work}/empty.json"
empty="$(digest "${work}/empty.json")"
[[ "${empty}" == "${empty_digest}" ]]
oras blob push "${push_flags[@]}" "${image}" "${work}/empty.json" >/dev/null

manifests='[]'
add() { manifests="$(jq -c --argjson descriptor "$1" '. + [$descriptor]' <<<"${manifests}")"; }
shopt -s nullglob
for zip in "${zips}"/kprint-*.zip; do
	target="$(basename "${zip}" .zip)"
	target="${target#kprint-}"
	case "${target}" in
		x86_64-unknown-linux-musl) descriptor="$(image_manifest amd64 "${zip}")" ;;
		aarch64-unknown-linux-musl) descriptor="$(image_manifest arm64 "${zip}")" ;;
		powerpc64le-unknown-linux-musl) descriptor="$(image_manifest ppc64le "${zip}")" ;;
		# the musl images and builds are the Linux ones
		x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu | aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) continue ;;
		*)
			if [[ "${target}" == *-unknown-linux-gnu && -e "${zips}/kprint-${target%-gnu}-musl.zip" ]]; then
				continue
			fi
			platform="$(platform_of "${target}")"
			descriptor="$(artifact_manifest "${platform}" "${zip}")"
			;;
	esac
	add "${descriptor}"
done
jq -e 'any(.platform.os == "linux" and .artifactType == null)' <<<"${manifests}" >/dev/null \
	|| {
		echo "No Linux musl build in ${zips}." >&2
		exit 1
	}

jq -n --argjson manifests "${manifests}" --arg source "${source_url}" --arg media_type "${oci_index}" '{
  schemaVersion: 2,
  mediaType: $media_type,
  manifests: $manifests,
  annotations: {"org.opencontainers.image.source": $source}
}' >"${work}/index.json"
cat "${work}/index.json"
oras manifest push "${push_flags[@]}" --media-type "${oci_index}" "${image}:$1" "${work}/index.json"
for tag in "${@:2}"; do
	oras tag "${push_flags[@]}" "${image}:$1" "${tag}"
done

set -eu

exe=$(realpath "${1:?Path to the kprint binary is required}")

trap 'rm -rf "${smoke_dir}"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# the repository CI runs in, or kjanat/kprint
repository_path="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-kjanat/kprint}"
repository="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}/${repository_path}"
homepage=https://dprint.kjanat.dev
description='Pluggable and configurable code formatter written in Rust, forked from dprint'

usage() {
	echo "usage: $0 render TAG SHASUMS DIRECTORY | publish TAG DIRECTORY" >&2
	exit 2
}

sha() {
	local asset="kprint-$1.zip" hash
	hash="$(awk -v asset="${asset}" '$2 == asset { print $1 }' "${shasums}")"
	if [[ ! "${hash}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
		echo "${shasums} has no SHA-256 for ${asset}" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	echo "${hash}"
}

render() {
	local mac_arm mac_x64 linux_arm linux_x64 windows_x64 windows_arm64
	mac_arm="$(sha aarch64-apple-darwin)"
	mac_x64="$(sha x86_64-apple-darwin)"
	linux_arm="$(sha aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu)"
	linux_x64="$(sha x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)"
	windows_x64="$(sha x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)"
	windows_arm64="$(sha aarch64-pc-windows-msvc)"
	mkdir -p "${directory}"
	cat >"${directory}/kprint.rb" <<RUBY
cask "kprint" do
  version "${tag}"

  on_macos do
    on_arm do
      sha256 "${mac_arm}"
      url "${repository}/releases/download/#{version}/kprint-aarch64-apple-darwin.zip",
        verified: "${repository#*://}/"
    end
    on_intel do
      sha256 "${mac_x64}"
      url "${repository}/releases/download/#{version}/kprint-x86_64-apple-darwin.zip",
        verified: "${repository#*://}/"
    end
  end
  on_linux do
    on_arm do
      sha256 "${linux_arm}"
      url "${repository}/releases/download/#{version}/kprint-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip",
        verified: "${repository#*://}/"
    end
    on_intel do
      sha256 "${linux_x64}"
      url "${repository}/releases/download/#{version}/kprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip",
        verified: "${repository#*://}/"
    end
  end

  name "kprint"
  desc "${description}"
  homepage "${homepage}"

  livecheck do
    skip "Updated on release."
  end

  binary "kprint"
  # for what calls dprint
  binary "kprint", target: "dprint"

  postflight do
    if OS.mac?
      system_command "/usr/bin/xattr", args: ["-dr", "com.apple.quarantine", "#{staged_path}/kprint"]
    end
  end
  generate_completions_from_executable "kprint", "completions",
    base_name: "kprint",
    shells: [:bash, :zsh, :fish]
end
RUBY
	jq -n --indent 4 \
		--arg version "${tag}" \
		--arg homepage "${homepage}" \
		--arg description "${description}" \
		--arg base "${repository}/releases/download/${tag}" \
		--arg x64 "${windows_x64}" \
		--arg arm64 "${windows_arm64}" \
		'{
			version: $version,
			description: $description,
			homepage: $homepage,
			license: "MIT",
			architecture: {
				"64bit": { url: "\($base)/kprint-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip", hash: $x64 },
				arm64: { url: "\($base)/kprint-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip", hash: $arm64 }
			},
			bin: ["kprint.exe", ["kprint.exe", "dprint"]]
		}' >"${directory}/kprint.json"
}

publish_file() {
	local repo="$1" path="$2" file="$3" token="$4" endpoint previous published wanted status content sha=''
	endpoint="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER:-kjanat}/${repo}/contents/${path}"
	if previous="$(GH_TOKEN="${token}" gh api "${endpoint}?ref=master")"; then
		published="$(jq -r .content <<<"${previous}")"
		published="$(base64 -d <<<"${published}")"
		wanted="$(<"${file}")"
		if [[ "${published}" == "${wanted}" ]]; then
			echo "${repo}/${path} is up to date"
			return
		fi
		sha="$(jq -r .sha <<<"${previous}")"
	else
		status="$(jq -r .status <<<"${previous}")"
		if [[ "${status}" != 404 ]]; then
			echo "Could not read ${repo}/${path}: ${previous}" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
	fi
	content="$(base64 -w0 "${file}")"
	GH_TOKEN="${token}" gh api --method PUT "${endpoint}" \
		-f message="Update kprint to ${tag}" \
		-f branch=master \
		-f content="${content}" \
		${sha:+-f sha="${sha}"} >/dev/null
	echo "${repo}/${path} updated to ${tag}"
}

publish() {
	publish_file homebrew-tap Casks/kprint.rb "${directory}/kprint.rb" "${HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN:?}"
	publish_file scoop-bucket bucket/kprint.json "${directory}/kprint.json" "${SCOOP_BUCKET_TOKEN:?}"
}

case "${1:-}" in
	render)
		[[ $# == 4 ]] || usage
		tag="$2" shasums="$3" directory="$4"
		render
		;;
	publish)
		[[ $# == 3 ]] || usage
		tag="$2" directory="$3"
		publish
		;;
	*) usage ;;
esac

name: AUR git package

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: { contents: read }

concurrency: { group: aur-git, cancel-in-progress: false }

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Publish kprint-git
    if: >-
      github.repository_id == '1092062077' && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    environment: { name: aur, url: "https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/kprint-git" }
    env:
      PKGBUILD: deployment/aur/kprint-git/PKGBUILD
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Pin the commit CI built
        id: pin
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        run: |
          commit="${HEAD_SHA}"
          if [[ -z "${commit}" ]]; then
            commit="$(gh run list --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --workflow ci.yml --branch master \
              --event push --status success --limit 1 --json headSha --jq '.[0].headSha')"
          fi
          if [[ ! "${commit}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "No commit with a successful CI push run on master" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          sed -i "s/^_commit=.*/_commit=${commit}/" "${PKGBUILD}"
          echo "commit=${commit}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          grep -E '^(_commit|source)=' "${PKGBUILD}"
      - uses: KSXGitHub/github-actions-deploy-aur@084b0d9b15415bf9cdb65d44dad1efe37a354050 # v4.2.0
        with:
          pkgname: kprint-git
          pkgbuild: ${{ env.PKGBUILD }}
          test: true
          test_flags: --clean --cleanbuild --syncdeps --noconfirm
          commit_username: ${{ vars.COMMIT_USER }}
          commit_email: ${{ vars.COMMIT_EMAIL }}
          ssh_private_key: ${{ secrets.AUR_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          commit_message: Update to ${{ steps.pin.outputs.commit }}

name: Benchmark
on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - deployment/**
      - website/**
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build ${{ matrix.build }}"
    runs-on: &ubuntu ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - { build: master, ref: "${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}" }
          - { build: pr, ref: "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}" }
    env: { CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0, LZMA_API_STATIC: 1 }
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ matrix.ref }}" }
      - uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@3551321aa44dd44a0393eb3b6bdfbc5d25ecf621 # v1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
        with: { key: "bench-${{ matrix.build }}" }
      - name: Build dprint
        run: |
          metadata="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1)"
          # the base branch's binary may still be named dprint
          read -r package bin < <(jq --raw-output '.packages[] | .name as $package | .targets[] | select(.kind == ["bin"] and (.name == "kprint" or .name == "dprint")) | "\($package) \(.name)"' <<< "${metadata}")
          cargo build -p "${package}" --locked --release
          mkdir -p dist
          cp "target/release/${bin}" dist/dprint
          git rev-parse HEAD > dist/sha
      - name: Upload dprint
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: "dprint-${{ matrix.build }}", path: dist, retention-days: 3 }
  bench:
    name: Benchmark
    needs: build
    runs-on: *ubuntu
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}", path: corpus }
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2.0.5
      - name: Typecheck the bench script
        working-directory: corpus
        # the workspace's nodeModulesDir is manual
        run: |
          deno install --frozen --entrypoint .github/scripts/bench.ts
          deno check --frozen .github/scripts/bench.ts
      - name: Rehearse the report with the fixture
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const { default: bench } = await import(`${process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/corpus/.github/scripts/bench.ts`);
            await bench({}, ["report", "corpus/.github/bench/fixture", `${process.env.RUNNER_TEMP}/rehearsal.md`]);
      - name: Download the builds
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:

name: Release binaries
run-name: "${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('Release {0} · {1}', inputs.release_tag, inputs.target) || format('Release {0}', github.ref_name) }}"

on:
  push:
    tags: ["*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Existing release tag to build
        required: true
        type: string
      target:
        description: Rust target to build, or all
        default: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - x86_64-unknown-freebsd
          - x86_64-apple-darwin
          - aarch64-apple-darwin
          - x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          - aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
          - riscv64gc-unknown-linux-gnu
          - loongarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - loongarch64-unknown-linux-musl
          - powerpc64le-unknown-linux-gnu
          - powerpc64le-unknown-linux-musl
          - aarch64-linux-android
          - x86_64-linux-android

permissions: { contents: read }

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      targets: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.targets }}
      ref: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.ref }}
      tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { sparse-checkout: .github/build-matrix.json, sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false, persist-credentials: false }
      - id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          INPUT_TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: |
          targets="$(jq -ce --arg target "${INPUT_TARGET:-all}" \
            'map(select($target == "all" or .target == $target)) | if length == 0 then error("Unknown build target") else . end' \
            .github/build-matrix.json)"
          tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          ref="${GITHUB_SHA}"
          if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == workflow_dispatch ]]; then
            tag="${INPUT_TAG}"
            git check-ref-format "refs/tags/${tag}"
            encoded="$(jq -rn --arg ref "refs/tags/${tag}" '$ref | @uri')"
            ref="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${encoded}" --jq .sha)"
          fi
          printf 'targets=%s\nref=%s\ntag=%s\n' "${targets}" "${ref}" "${tag}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  prepare:
    name: Prepare release
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { contents: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Create release if missing
        run: |
          if gh release view "${RELEASE_TAG}" --json id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Using existing release ${RELEASE_TAG}"
          else
            gh release create "${RELEASE_TAG}" --verify-tag --draft --title "${RELEASE_TAG}" --generate-notes
          fi

  build:
    needs: [plan, prepare]
    uses: $/.github/workflows/build.yml
    with:
      targets: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.targets }}
      profile: release
      ref: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.ref }}

  upload:
    name: Upload release assets
    needs: [plan, prepare, build]
    if: always() && !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success'
    concurrency:
      group: release-assets-${{ needs.plan.outputs.tag }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      artifact-metadata: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { pattern: kprint-*, merge-multiple: true, path: release-assets }
      - name: Require at least one binary
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          files=(release-assets/kprint-*.zip)
          if (( ${#files[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo 'No release binaries were built.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${files[@]}"
      # Releases before kprint had dprint-<target>.zip with dprint in it, which
      # their `dprint upgrade`, the installers and pins (ex. mise,
      # kjanat/install-dprint) still download.
      - name: Package the binaries as dprint too
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for zip in release-assets/kprint-*.zip; do
            name="$(basename "${zip}")"
            dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/dprint-zips/${name%.zip}"
            mkdir -p "${dir}"
            unzip -q "${zip}" -d "${dir}"
            for exe in kprint kprint.exe; do
              if [[ -e "${dir}/${exe}" ]]; then
                mv "${dir}/${exe}" "${dir}/d${exe#k}"
              fi
            done
            (cd "${dir}" && zip -q -9 "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/release-assets/d${name#k}" dprint*)
          done
          ls release-assets
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-path: "release-assets/*.zip" }
      - name: Upload binaries
        run: gh release upload "${RELEASE_TAG}" release-assets/*.zip --clobber
      - name: Update checksums for the complete release
        run: |
          gh release view "${RELEASE_TAG}" --json assets > release-assets.json
          jq -er '
            [.assets[] | select(.name | (startswith("kprint-") or startswith("dprint-")) and endswith(".zip"))] | sort_by(.name) |
            if length == 0 then error("No release binaries") else .[] end |
            if (.digest // "" | test("^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$")) then
              "\(.digest[7:])  \(.name)"
            else error("Missing SHA-256 digest for " + .name) end
          ' release-assets.json > SHASUMS256.txt
          gh release upload "${RELEASE_TAG}" SHASUMS256.txt --clobber

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      targets:
        description: JSON array of .github/build-matrix.json entries to build.
        required: true
        type: string
      profile:
        description: debug or release. A release build is packaged and kept as an artifact.
        required: true
        type: string
      ref:
        description: Commit to build.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      version:
        description: The version the binary reports (ex. a nightly's), instead of crates/kprint/Cargo.toml's.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions: { contents: read }

jobs:
  build:
    name: ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.build == 'freebsd-vm' && 90 || 60 }}
    defaults: { run: { shell: bash } }
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.targets) }}
    env:
      TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      BUILD: ${{ matrix.build }}
      PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile }}
      GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
      IMAGE: ${{ matrix.image }}
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      RUST_BACKTRACE: full
      LZMA_API_STATIC: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Set the version
        if: inputs.version != ''
        env: { VERSION: "${{ inputs.version }}" }
        run: |
          perl -0pi -e 's/^(version\s*=\s*)"[^"]*"/$1"$ENV{VERSION}"/m' crates/kprint/Cargo.toml
          perl -0pi -e 's/(\nname = "kprint"\r?\nversion = )"[^"]*"/$1"$ENV{VERSION}"/' Cargo.lock
          grep -qF "\"${VERSION}\"" crates/kprint/Cargo.toml
          grep -qF "\"${VERSION}\"" Cargo.lock

      - uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@3551321aa44dd44a0393eb3b6bdfbc5d25ecf621 # v1
        if: matrix.build != 'freebsd-vm'
      # a cache saved for a tag is only restored for that tag, so a release
      # would just push the caches branches restore out of the 10 GB limit
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
        if: matrix.build != 'freebsd-vm'
        with: { key: "${{ matrix.target }}", save-if: "${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}" }
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29 # v2
        if: matrix.build == 'zigbuild'
        with: { version: 0.15.1 }
      - name: Setup
        if: matrix.build != 'freebsd-vm'
        run: .github/scripts/build.sh setup

      - name: Build
        if: matrix.build != 'freebsd-vm'
        run: .github/scripts/build.sh build
      - name: Check glibc requirement
        if: matrix.build == 'zigbuild'
        run: .github/scripts/build.sh check-glibc
      - name: Test
        if: matrix.test && matrix.build != 'freebsd-vm'
        run: .github/scripts/build.sh test

      - name: Build and test in FreeBSD
        if: matrix.build == 'freebsd-vm'
        uses: vmactions/freebsd-vm@c46abacb49f09938ca4e1702d15d836285d694cc # v1.5.9
        with:
          envs: PROFILE
          release: "14.4"
          arch: x86_64
          mem: 8192
          cpu: 2
          # only packaging (release) uses what the VM builds, and copying all
          # of target back (gigabytes) can drop the connection
          copyback: ${{ inputs.profile == 'release' }}
          prepare: |
            set -eu
            pkg install -y curl git pkgconf
            curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o /tmp/rustup-init.sh
            sh /tmp/rustup-init.sh -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain none
          run: |
            set -eu
            export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"
            export CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_BACKTRACE=full LZMA_API_STATIC=1
            target=x86_64-unknown-freebsd
            release=''
            [ "${PROFILE}" = release ] && release=--release
            rustup show active-toolchain
            cargo build -p kprint -p test-process-plugin --locked --target "${target}" ${release}
            cargo test --locked --target "${target}" --all-features ${release}
            sh .github/scripts/freebsd-smoke.sh "target/${target}/${PROFILE}/kprint"
            if [ "${PROFILE}" = release ]; then
              # the binary is all packaging needs, so it's all that's copied back
              mv "target/${target}/release/kprint" /tmp/kprint
              rm -rf target
              mkdir -p "target/${target}/release"
              mv /tmp/kprint "target/${target}/release/kprint"
            fi

      - name: Test shell installer
        if: inputs.profile == 'debug' && matrix.test && matrix.build != 'freebsd-vm'
        working-directory: website/src/assets
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: ./install.sh
      - name: Test powershell installer
        if: inputs.profile == 'debug' && matrix.target == 'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: website/src/assets
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: ./install.ps1

      - name: Package
        if: inputs.profile == 'release'
        run: .github/scripts/build.sh package
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: inputs.profile == 'release'
        with:
          name: kprint-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/kprint-${{ matrix.target }}.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, the-big-split]
    paths-ignore: [deployment/**, website/**]
  pull_request:

permissions: { contents: read }

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  RUST_BACKTRACE: full
  LZMA_API_STATIC: 1

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { contents: read, pull-requests: read }
    outputs:
      code: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.code }}
      targets: ${{ steps.targets.outputs.targets }}
    steps:
      - id: filter
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          code=true
          if [[ -n "${PR}" ]]; then
            files="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/files" --jq '.[].filename')"
            grep -qvE '^(deployment/.+|website/.+)$' <<< "${files}" || code=false
          fi
          echo "code=${code}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { sparse-checkout: .github/build-matrix.json, sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false, persist-credentials: false }
      - id: targets
        run: |
          targets="$(jq -c --arg event "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" --arg ref "${GITHUB_REF}" \
            'map(select(.master_only != true or ($event == "push" and $ref == "refs/heads/master")))' \
            .github/build-matrix.json)"
          echo "targets=${targets}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  lint:
    name: Format and lint
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@3551321aa44dd44a0393eb3b6bdfbc5d25ecf621 # v1
      - uses: kjanat/dprint-check@29c42153a7346f4d7315883ff7722cfe22cd510c # v3.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
        with: { key: lint }
      - name: Check formatting with the current source
        run: cargo run -p kprint --locked -- check
      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings

  boundaries:
    name: Library boundaries
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@3551321aa44dd44a0393eb3b6bdfbc5d25ecf621 # v1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
        with: { key: libraries }
      - name: Check crate ownership
        run: python3 .github/scripts/check-crate-boundaries.py
      - name: Check independent libraries
        run: |
          for package in kprint-configuration kprint-formatting kprint-async-runtime kprint-communication kprint-owned-child kprint-plugin-types kprint-process-plugin kprint-wasm-plugin; do
            cargo check --locked -p "${package}"
          done
      - name: Check host libraries and lightweight test fixtures
        run: |
          for package in kprint-host-api kprint-platform kprint-discovery kprint-config; do
            cargo check --locked -p "${package}" --all-targets
          done
          cargo check --locked -p kprint-config --no-default-features
          cargo check --locked -p kprint-plugin-host -p kprint-host -p kprint-lsp --all-targets
      - name: Check facade feature combinations
        run: |
          for features in '' formatting tracing wasm process communication async_runtime process,wasm,tracing; do
            cargo test --locked -p kprint-core --no-default-features --features "${features}"
          done
      - name: Install Wasm target
        run: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - name: Build renamed Wasm API and facade fixtures
        env: { RUSTFLAGS: "-C link-arg=--allow-undefined" }
        run: |
          for feature in direct facade; do
            cargo build --manifest-path crates/kprint-core/tests/fixtures/wasm-plugin/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features "${feature}"
          done

  trace-analyzer:
    name: Trace analyzer
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2
        with: { deno-version: canary }
      - name: Check the generated trace analyzer script
        run: |
          deno task --cwd crates/kprint-development/trace_analyzer build
          git diff --exit-code -- crates/kprint-development/trace_analyzer/app.js

  build:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    uses: $/.github/workflows/build.yml
    with:
      targets: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.targets }}
      profile: debug

  ci:
    needs: [changes, lint, boundaries, trace-analyzer, build]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      code: ${{ case(contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') || contains(needs.*.result, 'failure'), '1', '0') }}
    steps:
      - run: exit "${code}"

name: Docker

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tags:
        description: >-
          The tags (ex. `nightly`), one per line, of ghcr.io/kjanat/kprint: an image for the static musl builds
          that ORAS also pulls the binaries of every platform from (see .github/scripts/docker-index.sh).
        required: true
        type: string
      release_tag:
        description: The release whose zips the image is built from. Without it, this run's artifacts.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions: { contents: read }

jobs:
  image:
    name: Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: read, packages: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
      TAGS: ${{ inputs.tags }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { sparse-checkout: .github/scripts, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: inputs.release_tag == ''
        with: { pattern: kprint-*, merge-multiple: true, path: zips }
      - name: Download the release's zips
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        run: gh release download "${RELEASE_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --pattern 'kprint-*.zip' --dir zips
      - uses: oras-project/setup-oras@5e2f2482b30b0cb3e14e67f89a80c88c659a7c63 # v2.0.3
        with: { version: 1.3.6 }
      - name: Log in to ghcr.io
        env: { ACTOR: "${{ github.actor }}" }
        run: |
          oras login ghcr.io --username "${ACTOR}" --password-stdin <<< "${GH_TOKEN}"
          docker login ghcr.io --username "${ACTOR}" --password-stdin <<< "${GH_TOKEN}"
      - name: Push the index
        id: image
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image=ghcr.io/kjanat/kprint
          mapfile -t tags < <(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' <<< "${TAGS}")
          .github/scripts/docker-index.sh "${image}" zips "${tags[@]}"
          echo "ref=${image}:${tags[0]}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@99012661954931238ded8c8b007157a8430204e1 # v4.4.0
      - name: Run the image
        env: { REF: "${{ steps.image.outputs.ref }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          index="$(oras manifest fetch "${REF}")"
          # the platforms with an image rather than an artifact
          platforms="$(jq -r '.manifests[] | select(.artifactType == null) | .platform | "\(.os)/\(.architecture)"' <<< "${index}")"
          for platform in ${platforms}; do
            docker run --rm --platform "${platform}" "${REF}" --version
            docker run --rm --platform "${platform}" --entrypoint dprint "${REF}" --version
          done
      - name: Pull the binaries with ORAS
        env: { REF: "${{ steps.image.outputs.ref }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          index="$(oras manifest fetch "${REF}")"
          platforms="$(jq -r '.manifests[].platform | "\(.os)/\(.architecture)"' <<< "${index}")"
          for platform in ${platforms}; do
            dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pull/${platform}"
            mkdir -p "${dir}"
            (cd "${dir}" && oras pull --platform "${platform}" "${REF}")
            files="$(find "${dir}" -type f)"
            echo "${platform}: ${files}"
            [[ -n "${files}" ]]
          done
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pull/linux/amd64/usr/local/bin/kprint" --version
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pull/linux/amd64/usr/local/bin/dprint" --version

        with: { ref: "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - id: plan
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base="$(sed -nE '0,/^version *= *"([^"]*)"/s//\1/p' crates/kprint/Cargo.toml)"
          sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          if [[ -n "${PR_NUMBER}" ]]; then
            name="pr-${PR_NUMBER}"
          else
            # a tag can't have a slash, and the version only has [0-9A-Za-z-] identifiers
            name="branch-${GITHUB_REF_NAME//[^[:alnum:]-]/-}"
          fi
          version="${base}.${name}.g${sha:0:7}"
          # the platforms npm and Docker previews are for, without their tests,
          # which CI runs
          targets="$(jq -c 'map(select(.target | IN(
            "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl",
            "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu", "aarch64-unknown-linux-musl",
            "x86_64-apple-darwin", "aarch64-apple-darwin",
            "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "aarch64-pc-windows-msvc"
          )) | .test = false)' .github/build-matrix.json)"
          {
            echo "version=${version}"
            printf 'docker_tags<<EOF\n%s\nsha-%s\nEOF\n' "${name}" "${sha:0:7}"
            echo "targets=${targets}"
            echo "ref=${sha}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "Preview ${version}"

  build:
    needs: plan
    uses: $/.github/workflows/build.yml
    with:
      targets: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.targets }}
      profile: release
      ref: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.ref }}
      version: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}

  npm:
    name: npm (pkg.pr.new)
    needs: [plan, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.plan.outputs.ref }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { pattern: kprint-*, merge-multiple: true, path: zips }
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version: 24.x }
      - name: Install the build's dependencies
        run: deno install --entrypoint deployment/npm/build.ts
      - name: Build npm packages
        run: deno run -A deployment/npm/build.ts "${VERSION}" --zips zips
      - name: Publish to pkg.pr.new
        working-directory: deployment/npm/dist
        run: |
          chmod +x @kprint/*/kprint
          npx --yes pkg-pr-new@0.0.93 publish --comment=update --bin ./kprint ./fmt ./@kprint/*

  docker:
    name: Docker
    needs: [plan, build]
    permissions: { contents: read, packages: write }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/docker.yml
    with:
      tags: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.docker_tags }}

name: Package Publish
on:
  release:
    types:
      - published
  # a nightly of the default branch, when it changed since the last one
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Version
        type: string
      nightly:
        description: Publish a nightly of the default branch instead (the version is ignored)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      dry_run:
        description: "Dry run (build and test npm, but skip publishing)"
        type: boolean
        default: true
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  plan:
    name: Plan
    if: github.repository_id == '1092062077'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      channel: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.channel }}
      publish: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.publish }}
      version: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.version }}
      npm_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.npm_tag }}
      docker_tags: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.docker_tags }}
      ref: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.ref }}
      targets: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.targets }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - id: plan
        env:
          NIGHTLY: ${{ inputs.nightly || false }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.version }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ github.event.release.prerelease || false }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == schedule || "${NIGHTLY}" == true ]]; then
            base="$(sed -nE '0,/^version *= *"([^"]*)"/s//\1/p' crates/kprint/Cargo.toml)"
            sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            # plain semver, without the fork's `-kjanat`, like the releases on
            # npm and ghcr.io
            version="${base%-kjanat}-nightly.$(date -u +%Y%m%d).g${sha:0:7}"
            # the last nightly is of this commit, so there's nothing new
            last="$(npm view @kprint/kprint@nightly version 2> /dev/null || true)"
            publish=true
            [[ "${last}" == *".g${sha:0:7}" ]] && publish=false
            {
              echo channel=nightly
              echo "publish=${publish}"
              echo "version=${version}"
              echo npm_tag=nightly
              printf 'docker_tags<<EOF\nnightly\n%s\nEOF\n' "${version}"
              echo "ref=${sha}"
              echo "targets=$(jq -c . .github/build-matrix.json)"
            } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            echo "Nightly ${version} (last: ${last:-none}, publish: ${publish})"
          else
            [[ -n "${RELEASE_TAG}" ]] || { echo 'No release version.' >&2; exit 1; }
            # the release tag is 0.60.6-kjanat; the image is tagged 0.60.6 and
            # 0.60 (and latest), like npm's plain versions
            semver="${RELEASE_TAG%-kjanat}"
            docker_tags="${semver}"
            if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" != true ]]; then
              docker_tags+=$'\n'"${semver%.*}"$'\nlatest'
            fi
            {
              echo channel=release
              echo publish=true
              echo "version=${RELEASE_TAG}"
              echo npm_tag=
              printf 'docker_tags<<EOF\n%s\nEOF\n' "${docker_tags}"
              echo ref=
              echo 'targets=[]'
            } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi
  nightly-build:
    name: Nightly build
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'nightly' && needs.plan.outputs.publish == 'true'
    uses: $/.github/workflows/build.yml
    with:
      targets: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.targets }}
      profile: release
      ref: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.ref }}
      version: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
  publish-cargo:
    if: github.repository_id == '1092062077' && false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@3551321aa44dd44a0393eb3b6bdfbc5d25ecf621 # v1
      - id: auth
        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@3268eb413133e2960fa4ae0e963ca76380c54cd9 # v1
      - name: Cargo publish
        working-directory: crates/kprint
        env:
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run && '1' || '' }}
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: "${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}"
        run: cargo publish ${DRY_RUN:+--dry-run}
  publish-package-managers:
    name: Homebrew and Scoop
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'release' && !github.event.release.prerelease
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: read }
    env:
      TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.version }}
      MANIFESTS: manifests
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Render the cask and the Scoop manifest
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          gh release download "${TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --pattern SHASUMS256.txt --dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}"
          .github/scripts/package-managers.sh render "${TAG}" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/SHASUMS256.txt" "${MANIFESTS}"
          cat "${MANIFESTS}/kprint.rb" "${MANIFESTS}/kprint.json"
      - name: Publish to kjanat/homebrew-tap and kjanat/scoop-bucket
        if: "!(inputs.dry_run || false)"
        env:
          HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}
          SCOOP_BUCKET_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SCOOP_BUCKET_TOKEN }}
        run: .github/scripts/package-managers.sh publish "${TAG}" "${MANIFESTS}"
  publish-aur:
    name: AUR ${{ matrix.package }}
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'release' && !github.event.release.prerelease
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions: { contents: read }
    environment: { name: aur, url: "https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/${{ matrix.package }}" }
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: { package: [kprint-bin, kprint] }
    env:
      TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.version }}
      PKGBUILD: deployment/aur/${{ matrix.package }}/PKGBUILD
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Set the release version
        run: |
          if [[ ! "${TAG}" =~ ^([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)-kjanat$ ]]; then
            echo "Expected a MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-kjanat tag, got ${TAG}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          sed -i -e "s/^pkgver=.*/pkgver=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}/" -e 's/^pkgrel=.*/pkgrel=1/' "${PKGBUILD}"
          cat "${PKGBUILD}"
      - name: Publish to the AUR
        if: "!(inputs.dry_run || false)"
        uses: KSXGitHub/github-actions-deploy-aur@084b0d9b15415bf9cdb65d44dad1efe37a354050 # v4.2.0
        with:
          pkgname: ${{ matrix.package }}
          pkgbuild: ${{ env.PKGBUILD }}
          updpkgsums: true
          test: true
          test_flags: --clean --cleanbuild --syncdeps --noconfirm
          commit_username: ${{ vars.COMMIT_USER }}
          commit_email: ${{ vars.COMMIT_EMAIL }}
          ssh_private_key: ${{ secrets.AUR_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          commit_message: Update to ${{ env.TAG }}
  build-npm:
    name: npm build
    needs: [plan, nightly-build]
    # the nightly build is skipped for a release
    if: always() && !cancelled() && needs.plan.outputs.publish == 'true' && contains(fromJSON('["success", "skipped"]'), needs.nightly-build.result)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
      ZIPS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'nightly' && 'zips' || '' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.plan.outputs.ref || github.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'nightly'
        with: { pattern: kprint-*, merge-multiple: true, path: zips }
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2
      - name: Install the build's dependencies
        run: deno install --entrypoint deployment/npm/build.ts
      - name: Build npm packages
        run: deno run -A deployment/npm/build.ts "${VERSION}" ${ZIPS:+--zips "${ZIPS}"}
      - name: Tar the npm packages (keeps file modes)
        run: tar cf deployment/npm/dist.tar -C deployment/npm --exclude='node_modules' dist
      - name: Upload the npm packages
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: npm-packages
          path: deployment/npm/dist.tar
          retention-days: 1
  test-npm:
    name: "npm test (${{ matrix.runner }})"
    needs:
      - build-npm
    # a skipped nightly build skips this too without always()
    if: always() && !cancelled() && needs.build-npm.result == 'success'
    runs-on: "${{ matrix.runner }}"
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults: { run: { shell: bash } }
    strategy:
      matrix: { runner: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest] }
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - name: Install Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - name: Download the npm packages
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: npm-packages
          path: deployment/npm
      - name: Extract the npm packages
        run: tar xf deployment/npm/dist.tar -C deployment/npm
      - name: Start Verdaccio
        run: |
          npx verdaccio@6 --config deployment/npm/verdaccio.yaml --listen 4873 &
          for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 30; attempt++)); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:4873/-/ping > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Verdaccio is ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
      - name: Configure npm to use Verdaccio
        run: |
          npm config set registry http://localhost:4873/
          npm config set //localhost:4873/:_authToken dummy-token
      - name: Publish packages to Verdaccio
        run: |
          for package in deployment/npm/dist/@kprint/*/ deployment/npm/dist/kprint/ deployment/npm/dist/fmt/; do
            npm publish "${package}" --registry http://localhost:4873/
          done
          version="$(node -p "require('./deployment/npm/dist/kprint/package.json').version")"
          echo "KPRINT_VERSION=${version}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
      - name: Create the test projects
        run: mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/npm-test" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/readonly-test"
      - name: Test npm install kprint
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-test
        run: |
          npm init -y
          EXPECTED_VERSION="kprint ${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          npm install "@kprint/kprint@${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          for command in kprint dprint; do
            ACTUAL="$(npx "${command}" -v)"
            echo "${command}: ${ACTUAL}"
            [[ "${ACTUAL}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}" || "${ACTUAL}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}-kjanat" ]] || { echo "Version mismatch: expected '${EXPECTED_VERSION}', got '${ACTUAL}'"; exit 1; }
          done
      - name: Test kprint via bin.cjs fallback
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-test
        run: node node_modules/@kprint/kprint/bin.cjs -v
      - name: Test kprint via simulated readonly file system
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/readonly-test
        run: |
          npm init -y
          npm install "@kprint/kprint@${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          rm -f node_modules/@kprint/kprint/kprint*
          DPRINT_SIMULATED_READONLY_FILE_SYSTEM=1 node node_modules/@kprint/kprint/bin.cjs -v
      - name: Test npm global install kprint
        run: |
          EXPECTED_VERSION="kprint ${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          npm install -g "@kprint/kprint@${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          for command in kprint dprint; do
            ACTUAL="$("${command}" -v)"
            echo "${command}: ${ACTUAL}"
            [[ "${ACTUAL}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}" || "${ACTUAL}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}-kjanat" ]] || { echo "Version mismatch: expected '${EXPECTED_VERSION}', got '${ACTUAL}'"; exit 1; }
            # verify the global bin entry points directly at the native binary, not bin.cjs
            if [[ "${RUNNER_OS}" = "Windows" ]]; then
              CMD_FILE="$(npm prefix -g)/${command}.cmd"
              grep -q "bin.cjs" "${CMD_FILE}" && { echo "ERROR: ${command}.cmd still points to bin.cjs"; exit 1; }
              echo "${command}.cmd correctly points to native binary"
            else
              LINK="$(command -v "${command}")"
              LINK_TARGET="$(readlink "${LINK}")"
              echo "${command} symlink target: ${LINK_TARGET}"
              echo "${LINK_TARGET}" | grep -q "bin.cjs" && { echo "ERROR: ${command} symlink still points to bin.cjs"; exit 1; }
              echo "${command} symlink correctly points to native binary"
            fi
          done
          npm uninstall -g @kprint/kprint
      - name: Test npm global install kprint (--ignore-scripts)
        run: |
          EXPECTED_VERSION="kprint ${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          npm install -g --ignore-scripts "@kprint/kprint@${KPRINT_VERSION}"
          for command in kprint dprint; do
            ACTUAL="$("${command}" -v)"
            echo "${command}: ${ACTUAL}"
            [[ "${ACTUAL}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}" || "${ACTUAL}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}-kjanat" ]] || { echo "Version mismatch: expected '${EXPECTED_VERSION}', got '${ACTUAL}'"; exit 1; }
          done
          npm uninstall -g @kprint/kprint
  publish-npm:
    name: npm publish
    needs:
      - plan
      - build-npm
      - test-npm
    if: always() && !cancelled() && !(inputs.dry_run || false) && needs.test-npm.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@22d081ff2d3a40755e97629de92e3bcbfa7cf2ed # v2
      - name: Install Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"
      - name: Download the npm packages
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: npm-packages
          path: deployment/npm
      - name: Extract the npm packages
        run: tar xf deployment/npm/dist.tar -C deployment/npm
      - name: Install the build's dependencies
        run: deno install --entrypoint deployment/npm/build.ts
      - name: Publish to npm
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.version }}
          NPM_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.npm_tag }}
        run: deno run -A deployment/npm/build.ts "${VERSION}" --publish-only ${NPM_TAG:+--tag "${NPM_TAG}"}
  docker:
    name: Docker
    needs: [plan, nightly-build]
    if: always() && !cancelled() && !(inputs.dry_run || false) && needs.plan.outputs.publish == 'true' && contains(fromJSON('["success", "skipped"]'), needs.nightly-build.result)
    permissions: { contents: read, packages: write }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/docker.yml
    with:
      tags: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.docker_tags }}
      release_tag: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.channel == 'release' && needs.plan.outputs.version || '' }}

files.README.md:
# dprint

<!--
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dprint.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dprint)
[![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/dprint.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/kprint)
[![Homebrew](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json.svg?url=https://formulae.brew.sh/api/formula/dprint.json&query=$.versions.stable&label=homebrew)](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/dprint)
-->

Monorepo for dprint—a pluggable and configurable code formatting platform.

## Links

- [Overview](https://dprint.kjanat.dev/overview)
- [Getting Started](https://dprint.kjanat.dev/install)
- [Playground](https://dprint.kjanat.dev/playground)

## Plugins

See <https://dprint.kjanat.dev/plugins/>

Repos:

- [dprint-plugin-typescript](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-typescript) - TypeScript/JavaScript code formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-json](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-json) - JSON/JSONC code formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-markdown](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-markdown) - Markdown code formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-toml](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-toml) - TOML code formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-jupyter](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-jupyter) - Jupyter notebook code block formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-dockerfile](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-dockerfile) - Dockerfile code formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-biome](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-biome) - Biome (JS/TS/JSON) wrapper plugin.
- [dprint-plugin-oxc](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-oxc) - Oxc (JS/TS) wrapper plugin.
- [dprint-plugin-prettier](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-prettier) - Prettier wrapper plugin.
- [dprint-plugin-roslyn](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-roslyn) - Roslyn (C#/VB) wrapper plugin.
- [dprint-plugin-mago](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-mago) - Mago (PHP) wrapper plugin.
- [dprint-plugin-ruff](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-ruff) - Ruff (Python) wrapper plugin.
- [dprint-plugin-exec](https://github.com/dprint/dprint-plugin-exec) - Formats code with any CLI executable.
- [Malva](https://github.com/g-plane/malva) - CSS, SCSS, Sass, and Less formatter
- [markup_fmt](https://github.com/g-plane/markup_fmt) - HTML, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Angular, Jinja, Twig, Nunjucks, Vento, Mustache and XML formatter.
- [pretty_graphql](https://github.com/g-plane/pretty_graphql) - GraphQL formatter.
- [pretty_yaml](https://github.com/g-plane/pretty_yaml) - YAML formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-gofumpt](https://github.com/jakebailey/dprint-plugin-gofumpt) - Go (gofumpt) formatter.
- [panache](https://github.com/jolars/dprint-plugin-panache) - Quarto, Pandoc, R Markdown, and Markdown formatter.
- [badness](https://github.com/jolars/dprint-plugin-badness) - LaTeX and BibTeX formatter.
- [arity](https://github.com/jolars/dprint-plugin-arity) - R formatter.
- [fatou](https://github.com/jolars/dprint-plugin-fatou) - Julia formatter.
- [dprint-plugin-swift](https://github.com/drluckyspin/dprint-plugin-swift) - Swift (SwiftFormat) formatter.

## Notes

I do a lot of this development in my spare time. Please consider [sponsoring](https://dprint.dev/sponsor) if you are a commercial company using this.
